meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在代理容器里把你附带的办公文档、文本 PDF、CSV 等转成 Markdown,并只围绕相关部分总结回答,不把文件上传;图片型 PDF 会失败,扫描 PDF 仍需 OCR,电子表格 Markdown 不适用于计算。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要读取你附带的 Office 文档、文本 PDF、CSV 等,且要求不把文件上传到云端解析服务时,会先在本机代理容器内转成 Markdown 再处理。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 转成 Markdown,再总结要点。
这份 PPT 附件讲了什么?概括一下。
say.note: Claude 会先转成 Markdown,再从中概括。

say.text: 把附件 CSV 转成 Markdown 表格并展示。
say.note: 转换在本地进行,文件不会上传。

howto.what_en: Installed: Claude converts docs like Office, CSV, or text-PDF to Markdown in-container and answers only from the Markdown; nothing is uploaded. Image-only PDFs fail; scanned PDFs need OCR; spreadsheet Markdown is not for calculations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to read attached Office docs, text PDFs, or CSV files and should keep conversion local instead of uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the Word attachment to Markdown and summarize the key points.
say_en.note: Claude converts locally and summarizes from the relevant Markdown.

say_en.text: Summarize what this attached PPT is about.
say_en.note: Claude converts it to Markdown, then summarizes from the converted text.

say_en.text: Turn the attached CSV into a Markdown table and display it.
say_en.note: The conversion runs locally; the file is not uploaded.
